title: AI on the Air: Behind the Scenes at IBC With Holoscan for Media
description: Launched this week in limited availability, NVIDIA Holoscan for Media is a software-defined, AI-enabled platform that helps developers easily integrate AI into their live media applications and allows media companies to run live media pipelines on the same infrastructure as AI.
